message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The case: construction without qualification, failure to ensure safety, leading to death of worker due to fall from height. This is a production safety accident causing death. In Chinese criminal law, this is "重大责任事故" (major responsibility accident) or "以危险方法危害公共安全罪"? Actually, for safety production accidents causing death, the crime is "以危险方法危害公共安全罪" (dangerous method endangering public safety) or "重大责任事故罪" (major responsibility accident). In examples earlier, similar facts (e.g., first two examples) were labeled "重大责任事故". Those were mining accidents and forklift accident causing death. So label should be "重大责任事故". The format: [罪名]重大责任事故<eoa>. Provide JSON with reasoning and final answer.
